title: 第15章 平安顿悟第16章 凝霜心思
content_zh:
“这家伙心性，毅力，天赋，倒也看的过去。”
“怪不得能让那个老家伙舍命守护。”
沈凝霜倒是越来越期待叶祈安会走的多远了。
要是让中州的那些顶级天骄知道沈凝霜如此看好一个男人。
恐怕会瞬间从中州杀到苍澜学院这个弹丸之地。
与此同时。
苍澜学院内院。
内院专属修炼洞天中。
一个身穿金色尊贵长袍，面容冷峻的男子从闭关中走出。
“地元境巅峰，距离天元境也仅有一步之遥了。”
紧接着一个小弟上前对着他小声说着什么。
他瞳孔一震，呵斥说道：“你说什么？”
“朱师兄，这可是真的，你的好弟弟在外院可是被叶平安揍的不轻，恐怕伤及根基。”
他不怒反笑，元气席卷周围，金袍无风自动。
“好好好！”
我朱家的人都敢欺负，看来是近些年我朱家沉寂得太久了。
让世人都忘记了朱家的威严。
“叶平安？”
“算是个什么东西？”
那小弟连忙上前说道：“朱少，您有所不知。”

“在你闭关这段时间，新加入了一个杂役弟子，就是这叶平安。”
“现在才进入外院不到一个月就从淬体境四重修炼到了地元境初期。”
那人听后双眼微眯，呢喃自语。
“一个月时间....地元境初期。”
“有点意思。”
这修炼速度比当年的他还快上几分。
这等天才，如果不能为他朱家所用，现又得罪了朱家，那就只能杀掉了……
“我弟弟的情况现在如何？”
“经脉有点受损，怕是有点影响外院的考核了，需要大量的丹药来修复伤势。”
金袍男子听后从纳戒中拿出一枚散发着浓郁丹香的药丸。
“拿去外院给我弟弟。”
那小弟双眼顿时散发着贪婪的目光。
“嘶，这是大还丹？”
“玄阶高级丹药！”
那小弟惊呼一声。
content_en:
"This guy's character, perseverance, and talent can be seen through."
"No wonder that old guy was allowed to risk his life to protect him."
Shen Ningshuang is looking forward to how far Ye Qian will go.
If only the top geniuses in Zhongzhou knew that Shen Ningshuang was so optimistic about a man.
I am afraid that they will be killed from Zhongzhou to a small place like Canglan College in an instant.
at the same time.
The inner courtyard of Canglan Academy.
There is an exclusive training cave in the inner courtyard.
A man wearing a golden noble robe and a stern face walked out of the retreat.
"The peak of the Earth Yuan realm is only one step away from the Tian Yuan realm."
Then a boy came up and whispered something to him.
His pupils trembled and he scolded: "What did you say?"
"Senior Brother Zhu, this is true. Your good brother was beaten badly by Ye Ping'an in the outer courtyard. I'm afraid his foundation was damaged."
He smiled instead of angry, his vitality swept around him, and his golden robe moved automatically without any wind.
"Okay, okay!"
Everyone in my Zhu family dares to bully me. It seems that my Zhu family has been silent for too long in recent years.
Let the world forget the majesty of the Zhu family.
"Ye Pingan?"
"What is it?"
The younger brother hurriedly stepped forward and said, "Master Zhu, you don't know something."
"During your period of seclusion, a new handyman disciple joined, this is Ye Pingan."
"In less than a month after entering the outer courtyard, I have gone from the fourth level of the Body Tempering Realm to the early stage of the Earth Yuan Realm."
The man narrowed his eyes slightly after hearing this and murmured to himself.
"One month...early stage of Earth Yuan Realm."
"It's interesting."
This cultivation speed is much faster than what he used to do back then.
If such geniuses cannot be used by the Zhu family and now offend the Zhu family, then they can only kill them...
"How is my brother doing now?"
"The meridians are a bit damaged, which may affect the examination in the outer hospital. A large amount of elixirs are needed to repair the damage."
After hearing this, the man in golden robe took out a pill exuding a strong fragrance of elixir from the ring.
"Take it to my brother in the outer courtyard."
The little brother's eyes suddenly glowed with greed.
"Hiss, is this the Great Return Pill?"
"Xuan-level advanced elixir!"
The younger brother exclaimed.
